subject: Re: SignalScale Dedicated capacity asks — trigger thresholds & staggered procurement
messages:
From: Sara Chen <sara@signalscale.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya R. <maya.procurement@signalscale.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask + target commit windows

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we had very positive feedback from infra and ML infra leadership. We are trying to map out procurement windows for a Dedicated contract that would span an initial 200 GPU equivalent pool with staged increases to 600 over 9 months. A few asks from procurement and engineering: 

- Can you confirm realistic OEM lead times (Axion / RedCore) for committed SKUs if we sign a 12-month reserved commitment? Procurement needs vendor ETA ranges (best/likely/worst) for hardware delivery.
- If OEM lead times push beyond our Q3 onramp, can Redwood offer a cloud backfill (public cloud reserved lane) as an interim? If so, what are the gating thresholds and cost uplift?
- We need a mutual action plan (MAP) to align milestones, acceptance tests, SLA ramp, and billing start dates.

Attaching a rough quantities worksheet and our procurement calendar. Would like to lock a go/no-go threshold (e.g., 60% signed by X date) that triggers the first OEM order.

Appreciate any details and who from Redwood we should coordinate with on vendor quotes.

Best,
Sara
Procurement Lead — SignalScale

Attachments: SignalScale_RQ-quantities.xlsx
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Chen <sara@signalscale.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask + target commit windows

Thanks Sara — looping in Ben and Karthik to scope procurement and cloud-backfill options. Copying Vanessa for commercial/ML onboarding timing.

High level response and proposal: 

1) OEM lead times: based on current vendor cadence (Axion / RedCore) we should plan:
   - Best: 8–10 weeks from PO to first racks in our colo partners (aggressive, needs immediate PO and expedited freight)
   - Likely: 12–16 weeks (most realistic given current BOM queue)
   - Worst: 20+ weeks (if vendor batch hits a prior enterprise queue)

   We have an OEM quote stub (Axion) attached — it's time-limited and assumes a consolidated PO.

2) Trigger thresholds / staggered procurement play: propose a three-lane trigger plan:
   - Lane A (Initial): >=50% signed by 2027-04-15 -> issue PO for 40% of initial pool (ships in one tranche)
   - Lane B (Top-up): >=80% signed by 2027-05-15 -> issue second PO for additional 60% of initial 200GPU pool
   - Lane C (Scale): commit tranche-based cadence for future increases to 600 based on quarterly signals and optional supplier reservation clause

   Rationale: splitting orders reduces exposure to worst-case lead times and lets us leverage earlier racks while vendor fulfills remaining tranches.

3) Cloud backfill: Karthik — can you confirm available reserved public-cloud lanes we can use as an interim and the expected cost uplift compared to on-prem SKU? Need an SLO for latency and cost multiplier (e.g., 1.4x) so SignalScale can plan budgets.

4) MAP & billing: Vanessa — we should draft a MAP with clear milestones: contract signed, PO issuance, first-rack live, acceptance window, billing start (we usually bill at first-rack-live or X days after acceptance). SignalScale asked for a MAP doc — I'll prepare v1.

Next steps: Ben, can you review the attached Axion quote and comment on consolidation opportunities? I'll prepare a one-page MAP and propose dates.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199

Attachments: OEM_quote_Axion-Inst_20270313.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sara Chen <sara@signalscale.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask + target commit windows

All — quick take after scanning the Axion stub and talking to procurement ops: 

- The Axion price looks market-competitive if SignalScale consolidates to one SKU family; mixing SKUs adds 4–7 weeks to lead time because of BOM alignment. Recommend locking a single SKU for the initial tranche.
- We can carve a cloud backfill lane through our cloud partners for up to 150 GPU-equivalent capacity with 1.35x token cost and a slightly higher latency envelope; we treat that as a temporary "capacity bridge" and apply a per-hour uplift on top of standard hosted pricing.
- Operational note: public-cloud backfill requires a data egress and ingress review; security team flagged a short questionnaire for SignalScale (SOC2 scoping + VPC peering checklist).

Staggered procurement idea (operational tasks):
- T minus 30 days to issue PO: finalize SKU and freight terms (Ben / Karthik)
- T minus 20 days: vendor confirms BOM queue placement (Axion lead)
- T minus 10 days: schedule shipping/colocation slot with our partner (Ben ops)
- Acceptance window: 7 days after racks powered and smoke-tested

I'll join the MAP drafting call tomorrow. Ben

Attachments referenced: none (see Axion PDF).
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara@signalscale.ai>, Maya R. <maya.procurement@signalscale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: SignalScale MAP & procurement trigger proposal (v1)

Hi Sara / Maya,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is MAP_SignalScale_v1.docx — it lays out the milestones, acceptance criteria, and the three-lane trigger thresholds we discussed. Summary below: 

- Milestone 0: Contract signature (legal countersigned)
- Milestone 1 (Trigger A): 50% of the committed value signed -> Issue PO tranche 1 (40% of initial pool)
- Milestone 2 (Trigger B): 80% signed -> Issue PO tranche 2 (remaining initial pool)
- Milestone 3: QoS acceptance and billing start (billing begins on first-rack-live + 3 days)
- Contingency: If vendor ETA > 16 weeks for any tranche, Redwood offers a cloud backfill option (upto 150 GPU-eq) with documented uplift of 1.35x and a security onboarding checklist to expedite peering.

Action items for SignalScale:
- Confirm acceptance windows and whether billing must start on contract signature or first-rack-live (we recommend first-rack-live).
- Complete our security questionnaire (I will share the link).
- Confirm if they want a single SKU for the initial tranche (preferred for lead time reduction).

Ben / Karthik / Vanessa — please review the MAP and vendor terms ahead of our call Monday 10:00 PT. I'll include the Axion quote appendix and the quantities workbook in the DocuSign envelope after SignalScale confirms the trigger dates.

Best,
Olga

Attachments: MAP_SignalScale_v1.docx, SignalScale_RQ-quantities.xlsx, OEM_quote_Axion-Inst_20270313.pdf
